note: Fixed narrator lines. They never contain guests' names. audio is the file name: a Show Pack keeps it in its own audio/ folder. Without the file, the line shows as a caption only.

lines.text: The glowing orb drops softly beneath its golden home…
The goblets weave, a dance of illusions! Keep your focus true!
The movement ceases. Where does the magic sleep?
Outstanding vision! You tracked the orb perfectly.
Alas, your eyes deceived you! That goblet holds only dust.
You hesitated too long, and the magic faded from view.
Remarkable! The whole gathering has the gift of true sight!
The speed quickens! Only a master seeker can trace this path.
